All work criteria records are created on a work criteria window. There 
 is one work criteria window for each type of work creation process. A 
 work criteria record manages the following activities: it determines which 
 work requests are selected for work processing; it creates a work unit; 
 and it determines the order that work instructions are generated and released 
 to the warehouse floor. The table below identifies the specific windows 
 that you will use to create criteria records.
shipping containers destined for dock locations

transfers or warehouse transfers (not 
 company transfers)
Work Order Finished Item Work Criteria

All work is created as a response to a work request. You will use the 
 Filter Data Tab on the work criteria windows (listed above) to define 
 which requests the system will generate work creation records for. Regardless 
 of the request source, a work criteria record manages the following activities:
Determines which work requests are selected for work processing.

Determines the order that work instructions are generated and released 
 to the warehouse floor.

Summarizes instructions within a work unit. Most 
 summaries are at the item level or location level.

Procedures: Creating a Criteria Record (Using the Filter 
 Data Tab)...

Before you identify which work requests will be processed, access the 
 appropriate work criteria window in the Configurations Explorer.

Use the Filter 
 Data Tab to indicate the values that the system will use to evaluate 
 work requests. The value list displays all of the filter criteria rules 
 in the order that they'll be processed. Both of these field sections are 
 described below. A work request record must meet the criteria defined 
 here to be processed by this criteria record.

Use the Order 
 By Tab to define how the system will generate the work for these 
 detail records.

When finished, 
 press OK. The system will save your work criteria record.

After you identify which requests will become work, you need to define 
 how that work will be organized. You will use the Order By Tab on the 
 work criteria windows to define the following parameters for a work instruction: 
 when the system will create a work unit, and the order that work instructions 
 are generated and released to the warehouse floor. During work creation, 
 the system references the records defined on this value list. The steps 
 below describe how the system processes these records. These processes 
 are provided in the order that they appear.

The system organizes the work instructions 
 based on the first record in the value list.

If the Work Unit 
 Checkbox is selected for an attribute, the system will create work 
 units each time a new attribute value is defined on an instruction. In 
 the example above, the checkbox is selected on the from location attribute, 
 the system will create one work unit per location. Note that you can also 
 create work units by defining a maximum record on the Work Creation Master.

Although the Work Unit Checkbox is described above, this list provides 
 additional considerations you may want to know as you use this tab.

You do not need to create work 
 units. If you don't use the Work Unit Checkbox on any rule in a 
 set, the system will organize the work based on the value in the Attribute 
 Field. So, if the attribute contains the value Location, all work be organized 
 based on its location number.

If you don't select a work unit 
 value, consider setting the maximums on the Work Creation Master 
 Window. The system will create work unit when it reaches the threshold 
 that you set here.

You can select 
 to create work units on multiple attributes. 
 In this case, the system generates a new work unit when any of these attributes' 
 values change.

These procedures should be completed after the record was created. The 
 instructions below assume that you have used the Filter Tab fields (on 
 the appropriate work criteria window) to establish how work requests are 
 accepted as work.

Procedures: Creating the Criteria Record (Using the 
 Order By Tab)...

Using the Order 
 By Tab: This tab has two field sections: the order by fields and 
 the value list. You will use the order by fields to organize how the work 
 instructions will be generated. For each record that you create here, 
 you can identify the following: the request record that the system will 
 use to organize the instructions, the order that they are organized (ascending/descending), 
 and if a work unit will be created at this request value. The value list 
 displays all of the records created on the order by fields. These records 
 are processed in the order that they appear in the list. Both of these 
 field sections are described below.

How multiple rules are applied: Regardless of the number of 
 rules defined on a Value List, the system makes one pass through the work 
 requests. If multiple rules exists, it applies each rule in the order 
 that they appear in the list. This strategy minimizes processing time 
 and streamlines system activity. Of course, multiple records can narrow 
 the number of request records that the system considers allocating product 
 for.

Use the Create 
 Work Unit Checkbox to group together work instructions into a work 
 unit. A work unit groups together work instructions to streamline processing. 
 The work unit is assigned to one employee. Note that you can select this 
 checkbox on multiple attribute records.
